body: For the current directory-layout and Project Memory maintenance slice, do not add, refresh, or rewrite repository identity prose or repository-identity links in canonical Project Memory. The broader identity-prose policy remains intentionally deferred; existing implementation details do not settle it.
creator: operator
rationale: The user explicitly chose to avoid repository-identity Obsidian polish and its extra complexity in this slice. This decision supersedes stale handoffs that asked to strip or reconcile identity links.
title: Defer repository identity prose changes
